title: Iron veins as a natural wiring network on the Giza Plateau

tellings.quote: It all emanates from the core of the central pyramid and the Great Pyramid and it spreads all across the Giza plateau connecting all of these various structures.

plain: Veins of iron in the bedrock of the Giza Plateau in Egypt are said to spread out from the core of the central pyramid and the Great Pyramid, linking all the structures across the plateau like a natural wiring network. The researcher Geoffrey Drumm describes this to Michels, without naming a source. If true, it would support his view that the pyramids were built to work together as some kind of power system.
